verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a prebuilt payment page via the Checkout Sessions API, embedded or Stripe-hosted, along with sandbox testing and test cards for simulating success and decline scenarios. A hands-on developer report says the docs are "clear and concise" and that they were accepting recurring payments in under an hour, which supports the under-a-day claim. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of copy-paste code samples per language for the core payment flow (only the machine-payments docs show a ?lang=node variant and sample repo), and recent independent corroboration of time-to-integrate, since the community report is old.
